mapper.insert: insert into notification (user_id, content, is_read, created_at, title, link) values (#{userId}, #{content}, 0, NOW(), #{title}, #{link})
mapper.select: SELECT notification_id AS notificationId, user_id AS userId, content, is_read AS isRead, created_at AS createdAt, title, link FROM notification WHERE notification_id = #{notificationId}
select * from notification where user_id = #{userId} and COALESCE(is_read, 0) = 0
select * from notification where user_id = #{userId} and COALESCE(is_read, 0) = 0 order by created_at desc limit 3
select count(*) from notification where user_id = #{userId} and COALESCE(is_read, 0) = 0

SELECT notification_id AS notificationId, user_id AS userId, title AS title, content AS content, link AS link, is_read AS isRead, created_at AS createdAt, CASE WHEN DATE(created_at) = CURDATE() THEN DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%H:%i') ELSE DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%c/%d') END AS createdAtStr FROM notification WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY is_read ASC, created_at DESC, notification_id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET is_read = 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
UPDATE notification SET is_read = 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND COALESCE(is_read, 0) = 0
UPDATE notification SET is_read = 1 WHERE notification_id = #{notificationId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT link FROM notification WHERE notification_id = #{notificationId} AND user_id = #{userId}
